plan.brief: Two friends, Alex and Maya, lock in concert tickets over iMessage: Alex proposes grabbing Neon Pines tickets, the seating options get browsed under one pinned heading, the booking is celebrated in the thread, and the finished ticket is in hand.

shots.purpose: Open the story: Alex proposes grabbing tickets and Maya says yes, establishing both friends and the goal.
shots.visual: Alex's draft types into the composer, flies into the transcript as a blue bubble, and Maya's gray reply arrives after a quiet beat. Header and composer stay fixed.
shots.copy: Neon Pines tickets drop at 10 - grab us two?

shots.purpose: Show the ticket options being compared while the screen context stays pinned.
shots.visual: A clipped rail of ticket-option cards slides left beneath the fixed 'Ticket options' heading; the GA Floor card gives way to Lower Bowl as the rail settles.

shots.purpose: Pay off the booking emotionally: Alex's 'booked' news earns Maya's excited reply and it gets hearted.
shots.visual: Alex's outgoing 'booked' bubble sits above Maya's incoming reply; the Love reaction arcs in and lands on Maya's bubble as a badge while the rest of the transcript stays put.

shots.purpose: Close with the secured ticket itself: the stub tears free, so the ticket is real and usable.
shots.visual: A Neon Pines ticket fills the card; its perforated stub tilts along the seam and drops away while the main ticket and backdrop stay pinned.
